findings.highlight: "N-nothing! Nothing at all! I am simply talking to myself! Let us eat!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「い、いえ、特に意味はありませんっ！　取るに足りない独り言ですので、早速昼食に致しましょう！」
findings.governingReading: 致しましょう is unusually formal here, and the next entry explicitly echoes it to ask whether her wording has changed.
findings.explanation: The marked formal wording and Shirou's immediate comment on it disappear.

findings.highlight: "Got it. Then I'll bring over the bento and some tea, so you two just wait here. We don't often have bento for lunch, so let's take the chance to eat here in the dojo."
findings.evidenceJa: 「わかった。んじゃ弁当とお茶持ってくるから、二人はここで待っててくれ。せっかくの弁当だし、たまには道場でお昼にしよう」
findings.governingReading: せっかくの弁当 uses the available packed lunches as the occasion; たまには modifies eating in the dojo.
findings.explanation: Occasional lunch in the dojo becomes rare bento lunches.

findings.evidenceJa: 「はいっ。期待しています、シロウ」
findings.governingReading: 期待しています explicitly anticipates the forthcoming meal.
findings.explanation: Looking forward to lunch becomes generic thanks.
